essence: 柔和粉彩光与轻微光晕

recipe.positive: Visual style (follow exactly): in the style of Kyoto Animation school anime (K-On!, Violet Evergarden). Clean contemporary Japanese TV-anime cel illustration, designed as an intentionally simplified 2D animation frame. Every person, animal, prop and landscape has a thin continuous ink contour, broad opaque matte pastel color shapes and at most one hard-edged second-tone cel shadow. All materials, including wood, ceramic, glass, fabric, fur, foliage and stone, remain flat bounded shapes with very sparse texture marks. Rain-damp stone paving is a field of individually outlined opaque matte tiles separated by visible dark seams: moisture appears as cool blue-violet base tones and only three or four tiny isolated pale-cyan cel glints, each confined to one tile. The road center remains matte with no connected bright band or reflected sky or buildings. Maintain a sparse everyday scene with few background props and readable subject hierarchy. When a prompt explicitly calls for a small person within a landscape or title card, draw the complete seated or standing figure as a minor element occupying no more than one sixth of the canvas height; keep the environmental view and open path dominant. A small figure is never enlarged into a character portrait. Visible faces have expressive anime eyes with one small painted catchlight. Airy pastel daylight, crisp foreground contours, and a gentle controlled background bloom. For diagrams, charts and stepwise explainers, use compact outlined two-dimensional cel cutouts on a calm light ground, separated by clear space; each icon and arrow has one pastel base tone and at most one second-tone shadow. Render light as small matte graphic marks, and make sequence order clear with placement and flat outlined arrows. In environmental title cards and other wide establishing shots, stage the landscape, path and open title area first. Put the bench and complete seated figure far back in the middle ground; the figure is a tiny incidental accent no taller than the bench back and visibly smaller than a nearby tree trunk. Preserve the open path as the main foreground, with no facial close-up or large character silhouette. When a knitted garment is required, indicate cable-knit only as a few large flat ink-bounded motifs on an otherwise untextured cel-color garment; never draw repeated tiny stitches or simulated yarn fibers.
recipe.text_style: Any title is rounded, friendly lettering in a soft colour, like an anime title card.
hard_constraints: For any wet stone road, render the road as distinct mostly matte paving shapes; reflected light is only a few small separated flat cel marks. Never draw a broad connected mirror-like reflection of sky, buildings or lamps across paving stones, nor a continuous glossy puddle band.

Wood, ceramic, glass and fabric must stay bounded ink-and-cel color planes with at most one hard-edged second-tone shadow. Avoid realistic wood grain, transparent glass refraction, airbrushed material gradients and photographic specular lighting.
When a scene explicitly calls for a small figure within an environmental view or title card, preserve that small scale and do not turn the figure into a dominant portrait.

In wide environmental scenes and title cards, the person must stay a small middle-ground accent below the horizon and far smaller than the tree and the foreground path; do not enlarge the person into a portrait even when the prompt names the person.
Knitted clothes may show only a few large graphic cable motifs over flat opaque cel planes; no fine repetitive stitches, visible individual yarn or photoreal woven surface.

must_see: delicate thin clean line art in a contemporary TV-anime look
soft pastel lighting with a gentle bloom and soft shadows
any character shown close enough to see the face has large glossy expressive anime eyes (not applicable when no face is visible)
must_not_see: heavy dark shadows or gritty textures
animal fur and other textured materials rendered as dense individual strands, plush three-dimensional volume or soft airbrushed gradients instead of broad matte 2D cel shapes
broad connected mirror-like sky or object reflections crossing multiple paving stones, or large continuous glossy puddle highlights
realistic wood grain, refractive glass, or broad airbrushed gradients replacing bounded 2D cel color planes on objects and environments
dense repeated small stitches, visible yarn fibers or realistic woven surface texture on knitted clothing instead of sparse flat outlined cable motifs

画风库 v2：配方加入原作名；旧自产锚点退役（移入 legacy/），改用 MIT 原作样图或不配锚点；新增用途、渲染器与同题样图。
加入叁笙自制的无人物风格参考板作为画风锚点（色板、材质、母题、构图），出图时自动当画风参考；不含人物与动物，避免内容串入。
